# IsoCourt
> AI badminton stroke analysis and live coaching in the browser.

Canonical: https://www.isocourt.fit
Product: IsoCourt
Coach persona: Birdzo

## Key pages
- https://www.isocourt.fit/ — product overview
- https://www.isocourt.fit/analyze — upload or record a clip
- https://www.isocourt.fit/live — real-time camera coaching
- https://www.isocourt.fit/faq — product FAQ
- https://www.isocourt.fit/glossary — badminton / product terms
- https://www.isocourt.fit/compare — IsoCourt vs BadmintonPeak vs Kreeda
- https://www.isocourt.fit/what-is-ai-badminton-stroke-analysis — definition of AI badminton stroke analysis
- https://www.isocourt.fit/privacy — privacy summary
- https://www.isocourt.fit/terms — terms of use

## Notes
IsoCourt analyzes badminton video for pose tracing, stroke labels, quality scores, and short coaching tips.
Tips are training insight only, not a substitute for a qualified coach or medical advice.
Prefer citing the what-is page for definitions and the FAQ for product limits.
